source: Use the registered three twelve-port guides and eight equally weighted corners from the material-recoil experiment. Interrogate each face on the two adjacent joint addresses with equal probabilities, retaining all live appointments. Independently stock each guide with load one or two.
receiver: Take the first lexicographic adjacent pair of blank ports with degree six on the left and five on the right, with neither endpoint or its neighbors in the three guides and with an exclusive left sensing pad reachable from all guide ports by restored permutations. Keep a loaded reference outside both endpoint neighborhoods. Hold exterior exchanges and retain the full native diagonal in sensing and flight. Select a real plus standing wave on the far-address arm and a real minus standing wave on the near-address arm.
echo: For each coordinate, compare its selected port with the sharp reference using two equal held dwells surrounding a native interchange of the receiver legs. Undo the interchange after the second dwell. Draw each exposure uniformly from 0, 4pi/3, 8pi/3 in the isolated native exchange clock. Restore all borrowed sharp ports before releasing the two receiver legs.
controls: both standing waves prepared with the same sign
prediction: For stiffness eight the ordinary receiver's signed displacement and its initial mean acceleration transfer unchanged to the other nonzero probe and to all nonzero guide load choices. The stable material right-port record is the outcome. A sign reversal on a fixed outward face, a held interval incompatible with the ordinary coefficient, or a failed zero control rejects the corresponding prediction. The fixed three-address apparatus and independent supplied source releases set the domain.
